subject.title: refactor(whatsapp): centralize inbound turn admission and history finalization

question: Should `mapChannelIngressDecisionToTurnAdmission` become a supported public export of `plugin-sdk/channel-ingress-runtime`, or should this mapping remain private to the migrated receive-path implementation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but adding a documented Plugin SDK export establishes a long-lived external contract and determines where future channels must own ingress-to-turn translation.

options.title: Accept the SDK mapper contract
options.body: Approve the narrow public mapper as the canonical receive-path bridge and merge after normal rebase and focused lifecycle validation.

options.title: Keep the mapper internal
options.body: Move the mapping behind an internal shared channel helper and keep the public SDK subpath unchanged if maintainers do not want to support this plugin API.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK mapper contract
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow public mapper as the canonical receive-path bridge and merge after normal rebase and focused lifecycle validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The author requested their attention and the decision spans the shared channel-turn and Plugin SDK boundary.
